node.title: Re^2: Extracting text from MS Word files on a Linux box
node.author: Laurent_R
node.doctext: Thank you very much [haukex] for your suggestion, I'll try it, but I suspect that this might very well work with recent <c>.docx</c> files (which have a format very similar to the open office format), but probably not with the old proprietary binary format associated with MS Office of 2003 and before. I'll give a try anyway.
